description: OCR a Japanese invoice (請求書) into structured JSON: vendor, customer, invoice id, dates, line items with tax rates, and the 8%/10% consumption-tax breakdown. The qualified-invoice registration number (T + 13 digits) is extracted AND verified against the National Tax Agency registry (active/cancelled, registered-name match, corporate record) in the same call. Accepts a LOCAL file path (PDF/JPEG/PNG, max 8MB) or a public URL. First 2 pages analyzed. Cost: $0.04 (x402/USDC). Failed analyses are not charged.

file.description: Local path to the invoice file (PDF/JPEG/PNG/TIFF/HEIF)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the invoice document (alternative to file)

name: read_japan_invoice
